mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under overcast skies with a waning crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City news today includes new guidance for erosion control and stormwater management permits for developers, alongside the exciting announcement that Deputy Chief Liz Gay has officially joined the team at Fitch-Rona EMS.

There is plenty happening around town, including live music at Paddy Mac's today and yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia at the Bogey Factory tomorrow and ART House 360 events coming up tomorrow as well.
Looking at the weekly police report, officers responded to a call on October 25 involving a driver who was taken into custody for O W I after being found at a local intersection.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed, but it will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
